newsitem.title: USA: Mrs. Clinton sings TV duet with Rosie O'Donnell.
newsitem.headline: Mrs. Clinton sings TV duet with Rosie O'Donnell.

text.p: Hillary Rodham Clinton, who admits she can't carry a tune, sang anyway in an appearance on "The Rosie O'Donnell Show" on Monday in which she said she and her husband want the country to lighten up.
"We're trying to get everyone in a good mood," Mrs. Clinton said on the syndicated daytime programme hosted by comedian Rosie O'Donnell.

She gave the candy-loving hostess a basket of M&M candies with the official White House label on them. For fellow guest Oscar the Grouch from Sesame Street, Clinton gave the puppet character a bag filled with empty M&M boxes, golf balls scarfed by her husband in practice sessions, an old tea bag and some towels.
Mrs. Clinton said she shared O'Donnell's love for the old Mary Tyler Moore television series and and for singing and dancing, but confessed: "I can't carry a tune, not even in the shower."

She recalled she was so bad that her Illinois high school teacher only agreed to let her appear in a school production of the Broadway musical "Bye Bye Birdie" if she would lip synch to a recording. "I was the original Milli Vanilli," she said, referring to the pop group best known for lip synching their songs.
But she joined O'Donnell in a duet from the musical.
The segment was taped last Wednesday and broadcast on Monday.
